anchor: kernel-time ledger is attributed term by term except a ≈0.7 ms remainder
claim_text: The kernel-time ledger accounts for all terms except for a remainder of approximately 0.7 ms.

adjudication.evidence: The database lists unmodeled components patch_embed_conv (0.495 ms) and gather_cat (0.257 ms) which sum to a remainder of 0.752 ms.
adjudication.query: SELECT SUM(ms) AS remainder_ms FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger WHERE n_images = 1 AND entry_name IN ('patch_embed_conv', 'gather_cat');

adjudication.observed: Across both ledger batches, N=1 has total 9.542 ms, attributed 9.541999999999998 ms, remainder 1.7763568394002505e-15 ms; N=64 has total 498.267 ms, attributed 498.268 ms, remainder -0.0009999999999763531 ms. Each has 7 attributed terms.
adjudication.evidence: The complete two-batch denominator shows only floating-point/rounding-scale remainders, while current v_pool_latency rows contain aggregate TTFT/ITL validation and no 0.7 ms kernel remainder.
adjudication.fix: Replace the ≈0.7 ms statement with: the seven categories sum to total kernel time within rounding error for both measured batch sizes.
adjudication.query: WITH ledger AS (SELECT n_images, MIN(total_kernel_ms) AS total_kernel_ms, SUM(ms) FILTER (WHERE entry_kind = 'category') AS attributed_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE entry_kind = 'category') AS attributed_terms FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger GROUP BY n_images), current_validation AS (SELECT sla_metric, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND run_id = 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src') SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n_images', n_images, 'total_kernel_ms', total_kernel_ms, 'attributed_ms', attributed_ms, 'remainder_ms', total_kernel_ms - attributed_ms, 'attributed_terms', attributed_terms) ORDER BY n_images) FROM ledger) AS per_batch_ledger, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger) AS ledger_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT n_images) FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger) AS batch_denominator, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(current_validation) ORDER BY sla_metric) FROM current_validation) AS current_validation

adjudication.observed: N=1 remainder=1.78e-15 ms; N=64 remainder=-0.001 ms (category sum equals total_kernel_ms to floating-point precision)
adjudication.evidence: collector_kernel_ledger category entries sum to total_kernel_ms within 1e-3 ms for both N=1 and N=64; no 0.7 ms residual exists in any fold
adjudication.fix: Replace '≈0.7 ms remainder' with 'no measurable remainder — category sums match total_kernel_ms to floating-point precision (≤0.001 ms across N=1 and N=64)'
adjudication.query: WITH cat AS (SELECT source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms, SUM(ms) AS cat_sum FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger WHERE entry_kind='category' GROUP BY source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms) SELECT source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms, cat_sum, total_kernel_ms - cat_sum AS remainder_ms FROM cat ORDER BY n_images
